title: Outside the Prompt — reproducible lab harness
description: Harmless canaries, MCP lab servers, test-repository generators, matrix runners, coders and read-only checks used in the 'Outside the Prompt' series to measure trust boundaries of AI coding agents: which project-declared MCP servers start and under which decision (part 2), and whether a client notices when an approved MCP tool's definition changes (part 3), with the per-run evidence, SHA-256 manifests and the preregistration deviations. No attack payloads: every component only records that it ran or what it served.
